title: Walmart Product Scraper Input
description: Scrape Walmart products as an Amazon-alternative product intel feed. Paste search URLs, category URLs, or direct product URLs. Each product ships as one dataset row.

startUrls.title: Walmart URLs
startUrls.description: Walmart search URLs (walmart.com/search?q=), category URLs (walmart.com/cp/...), or product URLs (walmart.com/ip/...). Mix and match. Each is treated as an entry point.

itemIds.title: Direct item IDs (alternative input)
itemIds.description: List of Walmart item IDs to scrape directly. Skip if you are using URLs.

maxResultsPerStartUrl.title: Max results per start URL
maxResultsPerStartUrl.description: Hard cap on products returned per search or category URL. 0 means everything Walmart exposes for that URL.

deliveryZipcode.title: Delivery zipcode
deliveryZipcode.description: US zipcode used to set the delivery location. Affects pricing, availability, and shipping estimates. Leave blank to use Walmart's default.

extractVariants.title: Extract variant matrix
extractVariants.description: Pull all child item IDs, sizes, colors, and price points for products that ship in multiple variants. Built in. No extra cost.

extractSeller.title: Extract seller intel
extractSeller.description: Capture seller name and whether the listing is Walmart Fulfilled or sold by a marketplace seller. Useful for sourcing and competitive intel.

extractStock.title: Extract stock signal
extractStock.description: Capture in stock / out of stock / limited stock signal and any stock count text Walmart renders.

extractRatingHistogram.title: Extract rating histogram
extractRatingHistogram.description: Capture the rating split across 5, 4, 3, 2, and 1 star reviews when Walmart exposes it.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip item IDs already pushed in previous runs. Turn off to refresh stale rows.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of products processed in parallel. Three is safe. Higher concurrency triggers PerimeterX challenges faster.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential is required for Walmart at any meaningful volume.
